slides.title: Start with one useful thing.
slides.body: A small guide to building a better first version.

slides.title: Choose a real problem.
slides.body: Write down who needs help, what they are trying to do, and where they get stuck.

slides.title: Make the first step work.
slides.body:
Pick one input.
Produce one useful result.
Test it with someone who needs it.

slides.title: Compare the result.
slides.body:
Before: a repeated manual task.

After: a simpler way to finish it.

Describe what changed without inventing numbers.

slides.title: Let evidence change the plan.
slides.body: A useful test tells you something you did not already know.

slides.title: What would you build first?
slides.body: Choose the smallest useful result. Start there.
